Remark
[Product rules for divergence, Laplacian, Hessian]

Source: petersen:page-0088 ↗ def:pet-ch2-divergence-lie-derivative ↗ def:pet-ch2-laplacian ↗ def:pet-ch2-hessian-lie-derivative

1. ch2:2.5.5For functions $f,h$ and a vector field $X$, \[ egin{aligned} \operatorname {div}(fX) & =D_Xf+f\operatorname {div}X,\ \Delta (fh) & =h\Delta f+f\Delta h+2g( abla f, abla h),\ \operatorname {Hess}(fh) & =h\operatorname {Hess}f+f\operatorname {Hess}h +df\otimes dh+dh\otimes df. \end{aligned} \] \sketch These follow from the Leibniz rules for $L_X$, $ abla $, and the gradient.
